relation_algorithm: Exact two-dimensional Gauss reduction, a stronger special case satisfying the stated 3/4-LLL norm bound
rank_failure: Preserved as the literal FAIL output
comparator: Independent uniform residues followed by independent finite Gaussian-weight conditional lifts
zero_mass_coset_policy: Assert every residue has positive lift mass for these declared finite supports; otherwise stop and report failure, do not divide by zero or resample
precision: Exact arbitrary-precision integers and Fraction probabilities
